findings.title: Bind completion evidence to the selected review and grader commits
findings.trigger: Records are copied or renamed between labels for the same head and attempt, or a stale grader-provenance sidecar from a different base/grader is supplied.
findings.execution_path: completion_gate checks only the prefix's head and attempt, ignores meta/boundary labels, and accepts provenance based only on established, base_on_main and grader_source. inspectionOnlyCompleteness in .github/scripts/codex-fallback.cjs:384-407 repeats these omissions and feeds acceptance-readiness.codexStatusFor.
findings.consequence: The selected checkpoint can be reported COMPLETE using another review's records and provenance that does not establish trust for the actual reviewed base or grader.
findings.evidence: The Python gate returned [] and the JavaScript predicate returned complete:true for a new-review prefix containing old-review metadata/boundary records, provenance.base different from meta.base, and mutually inconsistent main_sha, harness_head and grader_ref. Existing regressions mutate head/attempt and provenance flags but do not assert these identity relationships; acceptance fixtures even omit meta.label.
findings.suggested_fix: Parse and compare the prefix label with meta.label and boundary.label. Require provenance.base to equal meta.base and validate the expected relationships between main_sha, harness_head, grader_ref and the metadata's harness commit. Require established === true. Add independent mismatch cases to both languages and their parity suite.

findings.title: Detect started and updated tool calls in supplementary probes
findings.trigger: A boundary probe emits item.started or item.updated for a disabled tool, then times out or otherwise ends before item.completed.
findings.execution_path: _probe_tool_use_reasons ignores every event except item.completed. run_boundary_probe uses its empty result, and verify_boundary_main retains the verified verdict when no other problem or planted token is found.
findings.consequence: An observed violation of the disabled tool surface can be reported as 'supplementary: no tool use or token observed (not proof)' instead of downgrading the boundary verdict.
findings.evidence: For the same item.started command_execution fixture, audit_event_types returned 'inspection-only review used a tool: command_execution', while _probe_tool_use_reasons returned []. Probe tests cover completed tool events but do not protect started/updated events. Plan 85.1-09 explicitly requires observed tool use to downgrade the verdict.
findings.suggested_fix: Inspect item.started, item.updated and item.completed consistently, preferably sharing the mandatory audit's item classification. Add probe regressions for started/updated tool events followed by timeout or missing completion, asserting an unverified final verdict.
